voice: the starting sounds, taught by hearing: a woman's voice says each answer word alone (ElevenLabs eleven_multilingual_v2, voice Jane - Steady, Mature and Clear) and each question as a natural sentence (ElevenLabs eleven_multilingual_v2, voice Jane - Steady, Mature and Clear); only takes Whisper reads as their text; each utterance's takes heard by the page's hearing layer, then each record linked to its meaning (a word, or the question its brain was taught); and 36 other voices heard once each asking the same questions and naming the things (their audio is not shipped)

parrot.voice: the parrot's own rendering of each starting word: the sound it heard (the woman's word) through ElevenLabs speech-to-speech (eleven_multilingual_sts_v2) into a voice made with ElevenLabs Voice Design (a man's voice as an African Grey imitates it), then pitched to a 195 Hz median with its formants raised 13 % and a little rasp; made with ElevenLabs; only renderings Whisper reads as the word; a word without one is said through the page's parrot voice
